    The canonical basic Morita representative #

    For a finite indecomposable skeleton of finitely generated right modules, let G be the biproduct of one representative of every indecomposable projective. The represented functor Hom(G, -) identifies the original finitely generated module category with the finitely generated right modules over End(G).

    This file packages that elementary projective-generator Morita equivalence. It uses no structural input about special biserial or string algebras.
